scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king in red and cream robes holds a hand over his heart beside stone-lined irrigation channels that curve and divide through a sunlit orchard, with a town and mountains beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene portraying the verse's comparison of a king's heart in Yahweh's hand to water channels He turns as He wishes.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler stands at a fork in a sunlit, rocky landscape, while a bronze balance nearby holds a heart-shaped clay form in one pan.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 21:2, suggesting a person's chosen way and Yahweh's weighing of hearts.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, an elderly man gives a small pouch to a seated woman while another man watches. A stone altar with grain stands behind them among trees and village buildings.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses fair dealing and a nearby offering to evoke the verse's teaching that doing righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man lifts his chin proudly beside a wooden plow drawn by oxen through a field, where uprooted plants lie near a cultivated plot; another farmer watches from a short distance, with olive trees and a stone village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects a haughty look and proud heart with the verse’s image of the plowing of the wicked as sin; the damaged plants and watching farmer are invented details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A farmer carefully sows orderly rows beside baskets of produce and gathered grain, while a hurried neighbor spills seed from a torn sack onto a rocky, sparse plot beside a nearly empty basket.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative farming scene reflects Proverbs 21:5's contrast between diligent plans leading to plenty and haste leading to poverty.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient market, a smiling merchant reaches toward gold coins while a wary buyer watches. Some of the treasure becomes a pale drifting mist beside a path overlooking a deep ravine.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 21:6, picturing treasures gained through a lying tongue as fleeting and connected with death.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men are swept through a torrent pouring from a broken stone wall, among bundles, a chest, and a clay jar. A man watches from higher ground near a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the violence of the wicked bringing destruction upon them as they refuse to do justice, as described in Proverbs 21:7.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit landscape of olive trees and hills, a man carrying a tied bundle walks along a winding dirt path while a stoneworker lays a straight paved path toward a village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the guilty person's crooked way with the upright work of the pure in Proverbs 21:8.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits quietly on a rooftop corner at sunset, overlooking a village. Below him, a woman gestures toward a seated man in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting a quiet corner of a housetop with contention in a shared house, as in Proverbs 21:9.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a stern man clutches a basket of grain and looks back at another man reaching toward him in distress.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the wicked person’s desire for evil and lack of favor toward his neighbor in Proverbs 21:10.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient village courtyard, an elder points toward a man gathering fruit from an overturned basket as a young onlooker watches. Nearby, one seated man gestures toward a plant while another listens.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the simple person learning from a scoffer’s punishment and the wise person receiving knowledge through instruction.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two richly dressed men stumble on a rocky slope beside a basket spilling gold as the stone house behind them collapses under a shaft of sunlight.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 21:12, where the righteous God considers the house of the wicked and overthrows the wicked for their wickedness.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A poor man in worn clothing sits beside a stone doorway and reaches toward a richly dressed passerby, who turns away with one hand at his ear on a sunlit village street.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the cry of the poor being ignored in Proverbs 21:13; the verse warns that the person who shuts his ear will also cry out and not be heard.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man discreetly offers a small cloth pouch to a guarded, bearded man in a blue robe beside a wooden door.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a discreet gift offered amid tension, reflecting the proverb’s words about a secret gift pacifying anger and a concealed bribe addressing strong wrath.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, an elder hands a basket of grain to a smiling woman as another man looks on joyfully. Two distressed men recoil beside an overturned market stall, scattered grain, coins, weights, and scales.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene connects the joy of doing justice with the ruin of wrongdoing in Proverbs 21:15.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A weary man in ancient-style robes sits among rocky, unmarked tombs, looking toward a sunlit path through a golden landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a man resting among tombs after leaving the path evokes the proverb's warning about wandering from the way of understanding and resting among the dead.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A pensive man sits in a sunlit stone courtyard beside the remains of a feast, a wine jug, a spilled cup and a flask of oil. A sparsely filled basket and an open purse with a few coins lie on the ground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the proverb’s warning that loving pleasure, wine and oil leads to want rather than riches.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone town gate, a smiling traveler reaches toward his family while guards hold a somber man behind him; hills and buildings glow in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a righteous person delivered while a wrongdoer is held, echoing the proverb’s contrast between the righteous and the wicked.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits quietly beside a simple shelter among dry rocks and scrub. In the distance, a woman gestures from the doorway of a stone house, with sunlit hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the proverb’s contrast between dwelling in the wilderness and living with a contentious, angry woman.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, a man carefully tends a covered jar beside shelves of provisions while another man pours oil from a large jar onto the ground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the contrast between stores kept in the wise person's dwelling and the foolish person's squandering in Proverbs 21:20.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler pours water for a weary seated man beside a village path, while a donkey and villagers look on among fruit trees, flowers, and a flowing spring.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 21:21: the traveler’s care suggests pursuing righteousness and mercy, while the flourishing setting and welcoming villagers evoke life and honor.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man on a wooden ladder pulls stones from a fortified city wall as three armed guards look on in surprise; towers, a gate, trees, and distant hills fill the sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a wise man scaling the city of the mighty and bringing down its trusted stronghold, as described in Proverbs 21:22.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful man sits beneath a tree with a finger near his closed lips as two men argue in a sunlit stone village courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts restraint in speech amid a disagreement, reflecting the verse about guarding the mouth and tongue to keep oneself from troubles.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, an elaborately dressed man raises a dismissive hand and turns his chin upward as an older man gestures toward him; several villagers look on with concern.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the haughty scoffer acting with arrogant pride in Proverbs 21:24.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A dark-haired man in a blue tunic sits on a woven mat with his hands resting on his knees, gazing toward ripe grapes beyond an open gate. An empty bowl is in front of him, and a hoe leans against the courtyard wall.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 21:25: the empty bowl, idle hands, and untouched hoe suggest the danger of desire without labor.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a man offers a loaf of bread to a seated woman while another man holds a full basket of bread close and watches. Baskets of bread, fruit, and a clay jug sit nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Proverbs 21:26, contrasting continual coveting with the righteous person's generous giving without withholding.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a robed man rests a hand on a white lamb beside a stone altar stacked with wood. He clutches a small pouch against his chest and glances sideways; trees, distant buildings, and mountains fill the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Proverbs 21:27, in which the sideways glance and clutched pouch suggest corrupt intent behind a sacrifice.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Under an olive tree beside a stone gateway, a seated man gestures as he talks with a white-bearded elder and a group of listeners; another man walks away with his head lowered.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Proverbs 21:28's contrast between a false witness who perishes and a person who hears and speaks enduringly.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A red-robed man strides with his chin raised while another man crouches to place a stone in a rocky path, with a sunlit village and hills behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 21:29 by contrasting a hardened face with the upright establishing his ways.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four robed advisers pause beside a low table with blank scrolls and small carved pieces, looking toward the sun over mountains and a valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts human counsel with a vast dawn-lit landscape, reflecting the verse's teaching that no wisdom, understanding, or counsel can prevail against Yahweh.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man adjusts the bridle of a saddled brown horse on a rocky hillside while three figures carrying spears and round shields stand above a sunlit valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a horse readied for battle recalls Proverbs 21:31's reminder that deliverance belongs to the LORD.
